title: FIM acceptance after human editing

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: A delayed completion suggestion must be rejected if the buffer context that authorized it is stale.
hypothesis: Changing the prefix before accepting a suggestion should change the character tick and prefix validation even if a marker still identifies a live position.
minimal_fixture: One temporary code buffer, one suggestion snapshot, one simulated human edit.
predicted_behavior: The stale suggestion is rejected because tick and prefix changed.
observed_behavior:
marker=28 tick=6->9 accepted=nil text="def f(value):
    return x
"

independent_checks.name: buffer tick changed after human edit

counterexample: Accepting ghost text solely by marker position can splice stale text into a human-edited buffer.
derived_gym_requirement: Completion acceptance must validate buffer identity, modification tick, target range, prefix, suffix, and intended replacement before editing.
